commit.message:
feat(genseq): complete GenSeq app redesign and add manual entry

Rewrote genseq.rs from scratch with a finalized design:
- 3 faders × 3 latch layers for 9 controls (pitch att, length att,
  beat density on main; pitch length, legato, accent on alt; resolution,
  octave shift, gate length on third layer)
- Replaced beat-density Turing machine with direct fader control (0–100%)
- Added accent pattern derived from register_legato.rotate_left(8), giving
  correlated but independent legato/accent behavior from one register
- Accent CV output on jack 3 (10V=accented, 0V=not), velocity on MIDI
- Octave shift ±2 octaves on F1-Third, color-coded on button LED
- Gate length on F2-Third, shown as brightness on top LED
- Resolution colors (8 steps) on button 0 LED in third layer
- Removed: recording system, beat TM, latched_glob dead code, debug logs
- Reduced from join5→join4 (5→4 futures) by removing recording handler
- Gate % moved from param to fader control (stored in scene)
- Params reduced to 4: MIDI Channel, Base Note, Color, MIDI Out

Added GenSeq manual entry in ManualTab.tsx with full channel documentation
covering all three latch layers per fader.

Linear attenuation caused the lower half of the fader to feel unresponsive
because the quantizer only saw a compressed pitch range.

commit.message:
fix(genseq): fix octave shift clipping at negative offsets

Raise the quantizer input floor when shifting down so the bottom of the
pitch range maps to C0 instead of clipping negative DAC values to 0V.
Apply the octave shift in pitch space to avoid ±1 count rounding error
from the integer counts_per_oct approximation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
feat(genseq): add VoltPerOct and bypass quantizer params

Brings genseq in line with the other quantizer-using apps (turing,
clkturing, seq8, notefader) updated in #543.

- Add VoltPerOct param (Standard 1V/Oct / Buchla 1.2V/Oct); replaces
  hardcoded VoltPerOct::Standard in use_quantizer() and as_counts().
- Add "Bypass quantizer" param; passes raw register value through
  without scale quantization.
- Replace hardcoded 410/819 counts in input_floor with
  vpo.counts_per_oct() so the Buchla mode floor is correct too.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
refactor(genseq): redesign button/LED interactions and fix scene recall

- Third layer: activator moves from Btn0 to Btn2; Btn0/Btn1 now purely
  hold-to-mutate without side effects
- Mute: moves to Btn2 release, gated by a third_layer_used flag so
  navigating Third layer faders doesn't accidentally toggle mute
- Octave indicator: moves from Btn1 Button LED to Btn1 Bottom LED;
  Btn2 lights High while Third layer is held
- Alt layer button LEDs: show stored TM length on Shift press, switch
  to live tap count once counting starts
- Main layer Bottom LEDs: pitch TM cycle progress on Bottom0, length TM
  cycle progress on Bottom1 (both reset on clock Reset)
- Scene recall: fix glob_muted not refreshing after LoadScene
- Remove dead Storage field pitch_length_saved (never read or written)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
feat(genseq): curve LUTs, Euclidean progress LED, fix base note and register recall

- Replace isqrt pitch attenuator with Curve::Logarithmic lookup table
- Apply Curve::Exponential to accent density threshold
- Lower default base note from MIDI 36 to MIDI 12 (2 octaves)
- Add Euclidean cycle progress LED on Ch3 Bottom (euclid_step/len globals)
- Fix register_length recall: save back to storage each cycle and restore
  on scene load alongside register_pitch; recompute euclid_length immediately
